terms_clauses.clause_1_text: MonAmiChef uses artificial intelligence to generate recipes and nutritional descriptions. While we strive for excellence, you acknowledge that AI-generated content may contain inaccuracies or  'hallucinations' regarding ingredients, cooking times, or flavor profiles.
terms_clauses.clause_2_text: All nutritional values (calories, proteins, carbs, fats) provided are estimates and are marked as 'experimental.' They are not a substitute for professional medical or dietetic advice. Always consult a healthcare professional before starting a new nutritional plan, especially regarding high-protein targets.
terms_clauses.clause_3_text: You are solely responsible for verifying that any suggested ingredients are safe for your consumption, considering your personal allergies, intolerances, or medical conditions. MonAmiChef is not liable for any adverse reactions to food prepared based on its suggestions.
terms_clauses.clause_4_text: The application is currently in a 'Beta' or experimental phase. Features may be modified, interrupted, or discontinued at any time without prior notice.
terms_clauses.clause_5_text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. MonAmiChef reserves the right to terminate accounts that violate our community standards or misuse the AI service.

privacy_clauses.clause_1_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, including your email address, profile details, and nutritional preferences (such as protein targets and dietary restrictions).
privacy_clauses.clause_2_text: Your data is used to generate personalized saved recipes, calculate macros per serving, and improve our AI's ability to suggest recipes tailored to your lifestyle.
privacy_clauses.clause_3_text: Certain features, such as the ingredient checklist, are stored locally on your device and may be reset when you close the application.
privacy_clauses.clause_4_text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy_clauses.clause_5_text: You may at any time review, modify, or request the deletion of your personal data stored on MonAmiChef via your profile settings.
